name: GhostPopoverContent
description: Headless floating non-modal dialog surface for GhostPopover. Composes GhostPortal, useFloating, useDismissableLayer, and untrapped useFocusScope while staying unmounted (v-if) when closed.

props.name: as
props.description: Tag name or component rendered for the popover dialog surface.

props.name: flip
props.description: Flip to an opposite side when overflowing the viewport or boundary.

props.name: offset
props.description: Distance or axis offsets passed to `useFloating`.

props.name: placement
props.description: Preferred placement relative to the trigger.

props.name: portal
props.description: Teleport content through `GhostPortal` when `true`, or render inline when `false`.

props.name: portalTo
props.description: Teleport target passed to `GhostPortal` when `portal` is `true`.

props.name: shift
props.description: Shift along the cross axis to keep the popover in view.

slots.name: default
slots.description: Non-modal dialog content rendered while open.

exposed.name: blur
exposed.description: Removes focus from the floating dialog element.

exposed.name: element
exposed.description: Resolved floating dialog element while open; null when closed or unmounted.

exposed.name: focus
exposed.description: Focuses the floating dialog element when mounted.

parts.name: content
parts.description: Floating surface marked with class ghost-popover-content, data-part="content", and data-placement.

states.name: open
states.description: Applied on data-state while mounted and open.

keyboard.Escape: Dismisses the topmost open popover and restores focus to the trigger.
